content.short: 722 Capital manages onchain yield strategies for institutions, DAOs and family offices.
content.description: 722 Capital actively manages on-chain yield strategies for institutional clients, DAOs and family offices, and curates vaults on Hyperliquid. DAO treasuries have become a distinct client type for managers like this, since they hold substantial balances but rarely have the internal mandate or staffing to manage them.
